month_notes: October is Da Nang's wettest month, and from 25 October the winter schedule starts — the late-evening Korean bank from Seoul, Busan, Daegu and Cheongju grows again. Seven of those flights now land between 23:00 and 01:10.
empty_band_note: Two late Korean arrivals land after midnight

context.text: Da Nang International Airport handled 13.1 million passengers in the first nine months of 2026; Terminal 2 carried 6.8 million in 2025 against a design capacity of 4 million.

basis: based on flight schedules and queue times reported at the airport in 2025–2026
